answer: Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every karst settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
